2/9:
Based on the screenshots and the VB-NET test page you linked, the problem is that Prism’s built-in BASIC/VB grammar for string literals does not allow the at-sign (`@`) inside a quoted string. As soon as it sees `@"` it thinks the string has ended (or never began properly), hence the broken highlighting.

In `components/prism-basic.js` the string rule is defined as

```js
'string': {
  pattern: /"(?:""|[!#$%&'()*,\/:;<=>?^_ +\-.A-Z\d])*"/i,
  greedy: true
}
```

and in the minified bundle as

```js
string:{pattern:/"(?:""|[!#$%&'()*,\/:;<=>?^_ +\-.A-Z\d])*"/i,greedy:!0}
```

Neither include `@` in the inner character class. The fix is simply to insert `@` into that class (e.g. right after the caret), in both the full and the minified files.

Here are the two *SEARCH/REPLACE* patches you can apply:

```javascript

<<<<<<< SEARCH
'string': {
    pattern: /"(?:""|[!#$%&'()*,\/:;<=>?^_ +\-.A-Z\d])*"/i,
    greedy: true
},
'number': /(?:\b\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\B\.\d+)(?:E[+-]?\d+)?/i,
=======
'string': {
    pattern: /"(?:""|[!#$%&'()*,\/:;<=>?^_@ +\-.A-Z\d])*"/i,
    greedy: true
},
'number': /(?:\b\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\B\.\d+)(?:E[+-]?\d+)?/i,
>>>>>>> REPLACE
```

```javascript
### components/prism-basic.min.js
<<<<<<< SEARCH
comment:{pattern:/(?:!|REM\\b).+/i,inside:{keyword:/^REM/i}},string:{pattern:/"(?:""|[!#$%&'()*,\/:;<=>?^_ +\-.A-Z\d])*"/i,greedy:!0},number:/(?:\\b\\d+(?:\\.\\d*)?|\\B\\.\\d+)(?:E[+-]?\\d+)?/i,
```
